code:
schema_check: strict
null_check: order_id, customer_id
pk_check: order_id UNIQUE
duplicate_threshold: 0.5%
freshness_sla: 4h
volume_drift: ±10%

join: orders -> customers
filter: status != 'void'
derived: net_total formula
agg_check: daily_revenue
row_delta_tolerance: 0.1%

kpi: revenue, margin, orders
margin_threshold: >= 12%
revenue_tolerance: ±5%
report_binding: exec_dashboard
